detectorShapes.system-action: registerSystemAction(<literal|CONST>, …) — identifier args resolved via the constant table
detectorShapes.blueprint-launch: fireLaunchBlueprint(<CONST>) where CONST ∈ {POT_BLUEPRINT_ID, OVERWATCH_BLUEPRINT_ID} — classified by NAME, not value
detectorShapes.flag: FLAGS entries in libs/flags/src/types.ts whose KEY or VALUE names the tier
detectorShapes.prompt: blueprints/**/prompts/(mug|kettle|cup).md and files under a role-owned blueprint dir
detectorShapes.ui: .tsx named for the tier, or a sidebar/rail/tab file mounting a tier tab token
detectorShapes.wake: call sites of 16 wake/started-bit functions (one finding per function per file)

notCovered: live routine rows (harness_shared.routines) — query separately, see --sql
dynamic dispatch through a variable action name not in the constant table
prompt/doc prose mentioning the tier without offering it (deliberately excluded — prose is not an entry point)
coverage.readingRule: An empty category is meaningful ONLY when coverage.status === "complete". Read `unresolved` before concluding a surface is absent — this reports "none found", never "none exists".
